canonical_project: AzInTelecom Absheron Main Data Center, modules M1-M5
notes: Uptime Institute lists Tier III design certification for AzInTelecom LLC's 'Absheron Main Data Center' modules M1-M5 with location shown as Gobustan, Azerbaijan. EIB and AzInTelecom announced EUR 43M in financing for two green data centers in Absheron and Hajigabul, planned for completion in 2027; capacity was not disclosed.
